title: Named places of worship in Norway
description: Named places of worship in Norway, derived from OpenStreetMap POI nodes tagged amenity=place_of_worship in the EU-POIS/NO zoom-12 quadkey tile set. Named features only. Coordinates are the source node positions rounded to 6 decimal places; records are deduplicated on (name, coordinates rounded to ~100 m) and sorted by name. Filtered to a Norwegian bounding box (lat 57.9-80.0, lon 4.0-31.5, covering the mainland and Svalbard) to drop cross-border tile bleed. The source carries no administrative attribute, so no per-fylke split is provided.
